scope: 54 CH4 cases only, ew_png0d; not a whole-suite pass

measurement_parameters.baseline: linear, flank=3; 40/50/60% crossings and alternative flanks checked separately
measurement_parameters.noise_window: retrigger+1ms through poweroff-0.2ms, midpoint inclusion; padded peak detection
measurement_parameters.first3_latency_T: first latency plus mean wrapped differences of edges 1-3 from edge 1; no waveform shift
measurement_parameters.fit: wrap1536(latency + a*P + b*D + c*R - C); only C fitted, shared within width/mode/channel
measurement_parameters.primary_calibration: one affine CPU-log to hardware map per channel, all 54 fixed initial DAC-on edges
measurement_parameters.reference_delay: one constant from 54 reference-only initial DAC-on edges; no noise-edge calibration
